newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IPB buys Stratton TV Prima stake-CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech IPB buys Stratton TV Prima stake-CTK.

text.p: Prague-based Investicni a Postovni Banka a.s. (IPB) has bought back a 15 percent stake in the Czech television station TV Prima from Bahamas-based Stratton Investments, the CTK news agency said Friday.

It quoted an IPB spokesman as saying the purchase of the stake, which IPB sold to Stratton last year, was executed for an undisclosed third party. IPB officials were not available for further comment.
IPB owns a majority interest in the Czech company Premiera FTV, which holds a controlling stake in the station, which changed its name from Premiera TV earlier this year.
Poor ratings at Premiera, the second-place nationwide commerical station, put it well behind TV Nova, which claims a nearly 70 percent market share.

Stratton, created by Czech expatriate Viktor Kozeny and American expatriate Michael Dingman, bought its stake in the station after regulators said IPB was directed to divest some of its holdings in the station to conform with Czech law.
